facts.fact: 她羡慕所有母亲还在、且没有主动断绝关系的人（Bianca、Julie）；母亲今年本该五十岁。
facts.anchor: I was envious of everyone whose mother was around and didn’t actively disown them. I envied Bianca and Julie. Lupe knew her daughter and loved her and let her live her life. Julie’s mother didn’t know about her at all but she was proud of the things she could understand. My mother would have been fifty this year.

facts.fact: 童年有些时刻她希望没发生过：母亲叫不醒、她害怕、只能挨家敲门求助；母亲曾整整一个周末不见，而她学会用开罐器所以活了下来。
facts.anchor: There are moments in my childhood I wish didn’t happen, times when my mother wasn’t waking up and I was scared and I had to knock on doors to get help. She disappeared once for a whole weekend, but I knew how to use a can opener, so I survived.

facts.fact: 但至少她长成了自己想成为的人。
facts.anchor: But at least I got to grow up into someone I wanted to be.

facts.fact: 母亲唯一的失望是她退学——「我以为你会和我不同」。
facts.anchor: “I thought you were going to be different from me,” she said.

facts.fact: 她回敬「我不知道你还有标准」；多年来没那么愤怒过：母亲那样养大她，却在她能自主时开始审判。
facts.anchor: I didn’t know you had standards,” I said. It incensed me, in a way I haven’t gotten angry for years, that she could have raised me the way she did and, when I was old enough to make all my own decisions, she laid down the judgment.

facts.fact: 母亲反驳：别来这套，你从学步起就自己做决定——每天早上自己穿衣服。
facts.anchor: “Oh, don’t give me that. You’ve been making your own choices since you were a toddler. You dressed yourself every morning.”

facts.fact: 她没立刻告知退学（母亲当年「病症」很多）；现在她想自己当时该看出母亲身体多糟。但她从小就学会把一切归类为「Ruthie 的问题」，尽量与自己的情绪分开。
facts.anchor: But I think I registered whatever was going on as Ruthie Problems, which I had learned from a young age to keep separate from my own, emotionally, as much as I could.

facts.fact: 母亲从不直接开口要，但仍索取很多：对每个新住处、新学校都表现出兴奋（像新冒险）、每次戒毒都乐观——以及「做她活下去的理由」。
facts.anchor: To be positive every time she tried to kick the habit. To be the reason to stay alive.

facts.fact: 母亲最后的公寓在第十二街（圣马可墓地上盖的楼）：她没看见鬼，却有种被「又老又不赞成、慢慢才肯宽恕」的东西注视的不适感。
facts.anchor: There weren’t ghosts around—that I saw, anyway—but there was a feeling that made me uncomfortable, like I was being watched by something old and disapproving and slow to forgive.

facts.fact: Franny 是母亲老友（也是党人之后、去了巴黎、回来成了时髦女同）；母亲最后一次「river to rivers」时在街上遇见她，Franny 收留她看家——「也就是说，母亲最后一年，Franny 比我做的多。」
facts.anchor: In other words, Franny did more for my mother in the last year of her life than I did.

facts.fact: 母亲死后 Mark 与 Bianca 帮她清理公寓（她坐在沙发喝酒、哭、吐）；她睡在 Franny 的软床、哭进丝绸枕套，希望 Franny 是她母亲、或她是 Franny、或她们曾相爱，让母亲的命至少有一件事不同。
facts.anchor: And then they went home, and I slept in Franny’s soft bed and cried into her silk pillowcases and wished Franny was my mother, or that I was Franny, or that Franny and my mother had loved each other so that one single thing could have gone differently in my mother’s life and maybe it wouldn’t have all turned out this way.

facts.fact: 她给 Franny 留了母亲去世的纸条（她能做的最好的事）；数月后 Mark 说机上有 Franny 的留言——她把它擦掉了。
facts.anchor: I left Franny a note that my mother had died. It was the best I could do. Months later, Mark told me there was a message on the machine from her, but I erased it.

facts.fact: 她曾想母亲不显形是怕麻烦她（像帮她一个忙）；但 Mark 也没来，她只好承认有共同项——那个项是她自己。
facts.anchor: But since Mark, too, hadn’t shown up for me, I had to think there was a common denominator here, and it was me.

facts.fact: 结论：他们最难的时候她没到场，凭什么他们要为她到场？
facts.anchor: I hadn’t shown up for them, so why would they show up for me?
